headings.style: Friendly but structural. Avoid aggressive all-caps. Use tracking-tight for sizes text-2xl and above.

body.style: Highly legible, slightly rounded for approachability. Use leading-relaxed for long-form text.
body.sizes: Bump up default sizes for readability under stress. Use text-lg for standard body text, text-base for secondary.

rules: No aggressive ALL CAPS text blocks.
Use font-medium instead of font-bold for emphasis to soften the tone.
Never center-align paragraphs; maintain left-alignment for predictable reading patterns.
Ensure all text has a minimum contrast ratio of 4.5:1 against its background.

colors.backgrounds: Use massive amounts of calming neutrals: bg-slate-50, bg-gray-50, or pure bg-white. Zero dark mode or aggressive dark panels by default.
colors.brand_colors: CRITICAL: Keep the existing Tailwind color configuration exactly as is, but shift application. Do not use large solid blocks of the primary color if it is an intense red/black. Instead, use them as thin accents (border-l-4), text links (text-primary), or highly transparent backgrounds (bg-primary/5).
colors.interactive: Buttons can use the primary color, but soften them with rounded-full shapes and soft shadow-sm.
colors.states: Hover states should lighten (hover:bg-primary/90) or rely on subtle translations (-translate-y-0.5) rather than aggressive color changes.
colors.borders: Use ultra-light borders (border-slate-200 or border-border/40) to separate content without feeling 'caged'.

visual_enhancers.border_radius: Extremely generous. Use rounded-2xl for cards and modals. Use rounded-full for primary action buttons and pills.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Soft, diffuse ambient shadows. shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)] to make elements float gently rather than pop aggressively.
visual_enhancers.microcopy: Inject reassuring text globally. Empty states must say things like: 'No cases yet. We are ready to help you build your defense whenever you need.' Add tooltips with contextual examples next to complex legal terms.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Glassmorphism for the Immediate Help Panel (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/20) to make it feel accessible and modern without blocking the underlying context.

component_name.ImmediateHelpPanel: Floating or fixed right panel providing instant access to AI Chat and emergency steps.
component_name.GuidedCaseWizard: Replaces all raw forms. A step-by-step calm interface with a soft progress indicator.
component_name.SupportiveEmptyState: Illustration + reassuring micro-copy + clear single CTA.
component_name.CaseTimeline: Vertical line with soft rounded nodes, showing clear progress and next steps without legal intimidation.
component_name.AI_Chat: Conversational UI with generous padding, clear differentiation between AI and user, and suggested 'calm' prompt buttons.

grids.mobile: Single column (grid-cols-1) with massive touch targets (min-h-[56px] for buttons and inputs). gap-6 between major sections.
grids.desktop: Dashboard uses a clean sidebar (w-64) with a massive main content area. Content max-width should be restricted (max-w-4xl) to prevent line-lengths from becoming exhausting.
grids.wizard: Use a central focused column (max-w-2xl) with generous horizontal padding. Do not span forms across the entire screen width.

layouts.landing: Hero section -> Reassuring Value Props -> Seamless Signup. Heavy use of whitespace (py-24).
layouts.dashboard_shell: Side navigation with soft active states (bg-slate-100 text-slate-900 rounded-xl mx-2). Top header includes the 'Immediate Help' trigger.
layouts.cards: Cardless or 'Soft Card' approach. bg-white rounded-2xl p-6 md:p-8 border border-slate-100 shadow-sm.
layouts.forms: Inputs must be tall (h-14) with text-lg text. Use floating labels or very clear, non-jargon labels above inputs.

motion.transitions: Slow and deliberate. Use duration-300 or duration-500 ease-out. No snappy/aggressive animations.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up (opacity-0 translate-y-4 to opacity-100 translate-y-0) for list items and wizard steps.
motion.loading: Use reassuring text ('Analyzing documents...', 'Checking for violations...') instead of just spinners. Progress bars should move smoothly.

accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 48x48px for all interactive elements, preferably larger (56px) for high-stress mobile users.
accessibility.contrast: Strict adherence to WCAG AA. Ensure soft colors still pass contrast checks against white backgrounds.
accessibility.test_ids: MANDATORY: All interactive elements must have data-testid. E.g., data-testid='help-panel-trigger', data-testid='wizard-next-step'.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/50 focus:ring-offset-2) for keyboard navigation.

media.strategy: Empathetic, organized, and calming. Avoid stock photos of stressed people or gavels.
media.usage: Use sparingly. A soft hero image on the landing page, and maybe subtle icons/illustrations in empty states.

3d_libraries.usage: None. Keep the interface flat, fast, and completely distraction-free to reduce cognitive load.

hero_landing.description: Boy hugging woman calmly during daytime. Use for the main emotional anchor on the landing page.

documents_organized.description: Clean, organized workspace with a laptop on a wooden table. Use for the Document Generator or Case Files section to imply order and control.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. PRESERVE EXISTING LOGIC: You are overhauling the UI/UX. Do not delete existing backend integrations, state management, or AI routing logic.

2. COLOR MAPPING: Keep the existing tailwind.config.js color variables, but drastically change how they are applied. Remove solid dark backgrounds. Use pure white or very light grays (bg-slate-50) for the main application canvas.

3. GUIDED WIZARD: Locate the existing 'New Case' form. Break it down into a multi-step component (Wizard). Step 1: Upload/Describe. Step 2: Violation Review. Step 3: Defense Generation. Add a soft progress bar.
4. IMMEDIATE HELP PANEL: Implement a global floating action button (bottom right) that opens a Glassmorphic side panel containing emergency CPS response tips and a quick-link to the AI Legal Chat.
5. MICRO-COPY: Inject empathetic text globally. Replace 'Submit' with 'Continue to Next Step'. Add 'We are here to help.' to the empty states of the dashboard.

6. SPACING & SIZING: Increase all padding. If a card had p-4, make it p-6 or p-8. Increase base text size to text-lg and button heights to h-14 to accommodate stressed, shaking hands on mobile devices.
7. TEST IDS: Inject data-testid attributes into every single button, link, and form input you touch or create.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do not make generic centered layouts. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glass-morphism.
DO NOT apply universal transition (`transition: all`). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
DO NOT center align the app container. Maintain left-alignment for predictable reading patterns.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💡 etc.) for icons. Use proper icon libraries (Lucide React is default).
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, custom selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Components MUST use named exports. Pages MUST use default exports.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (kebab-case, role-based).
